news.title: What Just Happened To Marvell Stock?
news.summary: Shares of Marvell Technology (MRVL) fell 17.2% over the five trading days from October 9 to October 16, 2026. The broader market saw far less movement during that window, with the S&P 500 losing 1.9%. The stock first slipped the day after its October 6 Investor Day, an event where management actually raised its revenue outlook for fiscal 2028. So how hard was the week for Marvell, and what does its price still appear to assume.
